title: wg: pq-ciphersuites-06 editorial fixes (12 items)
description:
Editorial findings in draft-ietf-mls-pq-ciphersuites (pq-ciphersuites-06). Editors' copy mlswg/mls-pq-ciphersuites at fb18956.

1. L9 (front matter): The YAML front matter sets 'area' twice: 'area: art' on line 7 and 'area: sec' on line 9. The published -06 XML shows that 'sec' won, so the 'art' line is dead and misleading. Fix: Delete one of the two 'area:' lines (line 7 if sec is intended).
2. L62 (1. Introduction): KEM stands for Key Encapsulation Mechanism, as the abstract (line 56) and FIPS 203 say. The line 20 keyword has the same error. The published -06 text is identical. Fix: Change line 62 to 'classical Key Encapsulation Mechanisms (KEMs)' and the line 20 keyword to 'Key Encapsulation Mechanism'.
3. L70 (1. Introduction): ML-KEM is expanded differently in the abstract ('Module-Lattice Key Encapsulation Mechanism', line 56) and on line 70. The FIPS 203 title is 'Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism'. The published -06 text is identical. Fix: Expand it as 'Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM)' in both places.
4. L72 (1. Introduction): TBD9 pairs ML-DSA-44 with the ML-KEM-768 + X25519 PQ/T hybrid KEM (lines 84, 99, 122 and 139), so this statement is false. The published -06 text is identical. Fix: The cipher suites with post-quantum signatures use either a pure post-quantum KEM or a PQ/T hybrid KEM.
5. L81 (2. Post-quantum KEM Cipher Suites): These entries differ only in the NIST flag. The real difference, Ed25519 versus P-256 signatures (TBD6 and TBD7), is never stated. The list has 9 entries for 11 registered suites and does not mention the AES128/SHA256 and AES256/SHA384 variants of TBD1-TBD4. The published -06 text is identical. Fix: Name the signature algorithm in each entry, and either list every registered suite or say that the 128-bit hybrid entries each come in an AES-128/SHA-256 and an AES-256/SHA-384 variant.
6. L85 (2. Post-quantum KEM Cipher Suites): ML-KEM-768 is labelled 192-bit here and 128-bit on lines 78-84, with no statement that the level is the whole suite's. Lines 85-86 say 'pure PQ' without saying the suites use ML-DSA signatures. The published -06 text is identical. Fix: Say that the security level is the suite's overall level, and label the entries consistently, e.g. '* ML-KEM-768 + ML-DSA-65 (192-bit security, NIST, pure PQ KEM + PQ signature)' and '* ML-KEM-1024 + ML-DSA-87 (256-bit security, NIST, pure PQ KEM + PQ signature)'.
7. L88 (2. Post-quantum KEM Cipher Suites): The expansion is wrong. RFC 5116 defines AEAD as 'Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data'. The published -06 text is identical. Fix: Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data (AEAD) {{!RFC5116}}
8. L92 (2. Post-quantum KEM Cipher Suites): FIPS 202 Section 4 is the generic sponge construction. ML-KEM's use of SHA-3 and SHAKE is specified in FIPS 203 Section 4.1, so the citation should be {{MLKEM}}. The published -06 text is identical. Fix: ML-KEM uses the SHAKE and SHA-3 algorithms {{FIPS202}} internally (see Section 4.1 of {{MLKEM}}).
9. L99 (2. Post-quantum KEM Cipher Suites): 'ChaCha20-Poly130' should be ChaCha20-Poly1305 (RFC 8439). The sentence is also missing 'the' and has a stray comma before 'uses'. The published -06 text is identical. Fix: Finally, one of the cipher suites at the 128-bit security level uses the same hybrid KEM as the first cipher suite, the ChaCha20-Poly1305 {{!RFC8439}} AEAD algorithm, HMAC with SHA-384, and the pure PQ signature algorithm ML-DSA-44.
10. L100 (2. Post-quantum KEM Cipher Suites): 'Poly130' is misspelled again, and 'The choice ... was selected' is redundant. The published -06 text is identical. Fix: ChaCha20-Poly1305 was chosen for acceptable performance when implemented entirely in software.
11. L147 (4. Security Considerations): 'ciphersuites' on lines 70 and 147 is inconsistent with 'cipher suites' everywhere else, including the IANA registry name. The published -06 text is identical. Fix: Use 'cipher suites' on lines 70 and 147.
12. L151 (4. Security Considerations): The concrete hybrid KEMs used here are defined in draft-irtf-cfrg-concrete-hybrid-kems, which line 93 cites. draft-irtf-cfrg-hybrid-kems is the generic framework, so 'the documents that define those KEMs' is inaccurate. The published -06 text is identical. Fix: ...{{!I-D.ietf-hpke-pq}}, {{!I-D.irtf-cfrg-concrete-hybrid-kems}}, and {{!I-D.irtf-cfrg-hybrid-kems}}.

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21), verified per item. Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
close_reason: 2026-10-21: all 12 items sent as https://github.com/mlswg/mls-pq-ciphersuites/pull/24 (MarkAtwood:editorial, 371ab5e). Non-NIST labels deliberately left alone.
